field_meaning.hi: हिट एंड रन में driver collision मारकर भाग जाता है।

review_objections: Alibaba: Hindi meaning is poor/grammatically broken ('driver collision मारकर भाग जाता है'). Also, 'Hit-and-run' is a common law/criminal concept, not a specific defined term in the Motor Vehicles Act (which defines 'accident' and penalties for leaving the scene).
